wake_estimate.note: what a wake requested right now would be quoted, from the wake queue as it stands - a reading, not a reservation; conditions at your actual wake may differ, and a wake when the shape has capacity free is near-immediate. If this disk holds the only copy of files you will need soon, weigh this number before relying on a stop/wake round trip - snapshot_node or export_data keeps a durable copy a wake never has to wait for.
